entries.title: A task that waits to start says what it is waiting for
entries.body: When you ask for a premium model and none has allowance left, the task waits instead of starting on a lesser model. Its details now say so, and that it starts by itself once a premium model has allowance, or sooner if you ask Firstmate. A retry on a stronger model says the same for the model it needs. A task Firstmate set to start later says what it waits for: a model's allowance, your plan's allowance, or a time. Before, each of these said no reason had been reported yet.

picture.alt: A queued task's details titled Waiting for a premium model, saying no premium model has allowance now and that it starts by itself once one does.
